survey: A witch hat floating over a background of orange rings, seen from slightly above and in front. Parts: (1) A wide, flat, oval brim. Its top face is visible as a fairly open ellipse, its thickness shows along the front and bottom edge, and its long axis rises toward the upper right. (2) A tall cone that rises from the middle of the brim. Its axis is close to vertical, and the tip curls to the right, which is a stylized bend rather than a perspective cue. (3) A purple band around the base of the cone, where the cone meets the brim. Its lower edge curves down toward the viewer, so it is also seen from above. (4) A gold square buckle on the front of the band, facing the camera, which suits the front of a cylinder. The cone is placed about at the center of the brim's ellipse. Shading and the brim's visible thickness agree on one light and one view from above.

errors.where: The brim compared with the purple band and the cone base
errors.what: The brim's ellipse is turned so that its right side rises toward the upper right, which suggests the brim is rolled or tilted. The band's ellipse and the cone's axis stay nearly level and upright, though. The band is also much flatter than the brim, so the brim looks seen from higher up than the band it is attached to. If the cone sat square on the brim, the band's ellipse would lean the same way as the brim's and be nearly as open, or the brim would be level and match the band.

fix: Show the witch hat from a single slightly high three-quarter view. Make the brim a level oval whose long axis is horizontal. Center the cone on the brim with the cone's axis at right angles to the brim. The purple band should be an ellipse that follows the brim's angle and is only slightly narrower than it. Keep the buckle centered on the front of the band, curving with it.
